100% recommendation.

Dr. Dhammapoj and his team took very well care of me. His clinic and equipment are up to the latest standards. His examinations were very gentle and professional. He explained during the check-up and answered all my questions.
His English skills are excellent.

His clinic is modern, clean and he and his team are very engaged to take best care of their clients.

I needed an appointment at the same day and his team made it possible.
At my scheduled appointment, three other patients were there. My schedule was on time.

Currently, the clinic has not many ratings as he changed the name and location of his clinic. Previously, it was All Gen Medicare.

Please, do not hesitate to seek care from Dr. Dhammapoj.

P.S. the teddy bear on the shirt is so cute.

I am very grateful, thank you for taking care of me. 🙏
